methodology: The original research topic and the generated technical specification were decomposed into atomic units by identifying individual requirements, features, behaviors, and constraints. Each atomic unit is designed to be independent, self-contained, technically specific, unambiguous, and implementable as a single requirement. This ensures a granular comparison between the two sets of information.
mindtraced_atomic_units: Increments up to a maximum of 3
Decrements down to a minimum of 0
areset is a positive edge triggered asynchronous reset
state[1:0] is the two-bit counter value
module top_module(input clk, input areset, input train_valid, input train_taken, output logic [1:0] state);
spec_atomic_units: Module top_module(input clk, input areset, input train_valid, input train_taken, output logic [1:0] state);
train_valid acts as an enable signal
counter increments or decrements based on train_taken when train_valid is high
counter's state remains unchanged when train_valid is low
train_taken determines whether the counter increments or decrements
state[1:0] represents the current state of the counter
state is updated based on train_valid and train_taken, subject to saturation limits (0 and 3)
Increment if train_valid and train_taken are high
Increment only if the current state is less than 3
If state is 0, the next state is 1
If state is 1, the next state is 2
If state is 2, the next state is 3
If state is 3, the next state remains 3 (saturation)
Decrement if train_valid is high and train_taken is low
Decrement only if the current state is greater than 0
If state is 3, the next state is 2
If state is 2, the next state is 1
If state is 1, the next state is 0
If state is 0, the next state remains 0 (saturation)
If train_valid is low, the next state is the same as the current state
state output changes on the positive edge of clk
state output is asynchronously reset to 2'b01 on the positive edge of areset
areset overrides any concurrent clock edge triggered update
Design uses one 2-bit register, state
Register is updated on the positive edge of the clock (clk) or the positive edge of the asynchronous reset (areset)
Reset value is 2'b01
Increment and decrement operations are conditional based on train_valid and train_taken
Increment and decrement operations are subject to saturation logic to keep the value within the range of 0 to 3
